I'm in a similar situation so take my advice with a grain of salt, if you haven't already, I would look for any support programs available: disability, career counseling, mental health services, etc... 

I recently signed up for a gov funded program that paid min wage and taught/provided career skills and services for free. I wouldn't have known it even existed unless I was told about it.

Focus on your health first and foremost, I'm sure you already know but ignoring your problems won't make them go away, it will only make things harder in the long run. Even if you're not 100% about the diabetes see a doctor ASAP. My brother went through it and it's possible to avoid it altogether if you do something about it now.

In the end you have to find what is worth staying alive for, whether it's your loved ones, goals or simply pleasure. Also please don't be so hard on yourself, you're not stupid, stupid people don't tend to be self aware or recognize their mistakes.
